error_description: creator inadvertently combined donation and paid price controls as if they were alternative tiers; creator said that the resulting offered amount was too high
limits: One dated self-reported first-game account with zero copies; no matched exposure, price history, buyer checkout records or independent price reconstruction.
An inferred pricing-error cause would be unwarranted because competing discovery, launch quality and product-market factors are unmeasured.
The stated $9.99 multiplayer upper price is an intended ceiling, not a verified realized transaction price.
Platform documentation distinguishes project minimums and individual-file entitlements, but does not imply every exact purchase control always stacks numerically as one formula.
The developer did not disclose labor, cash outlay, subsequent paid units or a median commercial result.
